lessons_control.note: pre_lessons is each hunter's own sum before it read researcher_us/LESSONS.md. edge_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, which is the only thing that can tell the guidance file apart from a habit.

language_control.note: pre_local is each hunter's own sum after the ENGLISH pass and before the local pass. eu_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, per market, and does not pool the UK (where the second pass varies source locality) with Germany and France (where it varies language).

note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

findings.finding: Paychex publishes its own free monthly Small Business Employment Watch, and it covers exactly the June-August quarter about to be reported: June 2026 printed a jobs index of 99.83, the highest since August 2025 and a fourth consecutive monthly improvement, and August printed 99.13, in line with the 2026 year-to-date average of 99.20, with weekly hours growth positive for a sixth straight month — so the 'flat employment levels' assumption underpinning the FY27 guide held through the reported quarter even as the stock lost 9.79% in 20 days on hiring-freeze fear.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Filed as guidance rather than reported_quarter deliberately: on 2026-06-24 this name beat both reported lines and still fell 2.3%, and the sweep row states a reported-quarter beat here is worth close to zero. What this series actually settles is reaffirm-versus-cut on the annual guide, and the guide is what moved the stock -1.72% in June 2026 and -9.4% in June 2025. The counterweight is resolved inside this finding rather than left to argue against it: the index deteriorated WITHIN the quarter, from 99.83 in June to roughly 99.23 in July to 99.13 in August, so the data supports a guide that is reaffirmed and does NOT support one that is raised. outside_window.finding: UnitedHealthcare added updated step-therapy and prior-authorisation criteria for Exxua effective 1 September 2026 — a coverage restriction at the largest commercial payer that pressures the 'over 70% of commercial claims approved on first attempt' figure management gave in May, but whose revenue effect lands in FY2027 quarters reported long after this exit window.

Granules' Paragraph IV certification against Adzenys XR-ODT triggered a patent suit filed 11 December 2024 and a 30-month FDA approval stay that runs into 2027; resolution of that stay, not tonight's print, is what settles whether the ADHD portfolio erodes further.

Lesson 1 (the reaction function vetoes the fundamental read) cut the revenue-versus-bar finding from -1.5 to -0.8: this name printed a 33% revenue decline in May and moved +0.89%, so the reported-quarter line does not pay here however good the arithmetic is. It is also why print_vs_bar_pct (-1.0) and expected_move_pct (-5.0) are deliberately far apart.

Lesson 2 moved the impairment finding from one_off to reported_quarter — the file's stated exception is that an unquantified reported-quarter impairment lands on the line and is not in the price — and the size was left at -1.0 because I can source the trigger and the dated Metadate licence termination but not the charge.

Lesson 3 (your own caveat must reach the number) cut the adjusted-EBITDA finding from -3.0 to -2.5. The counterweight I had written into the text but not into the size is that the warrants were reclassified to equity on 2026-03-31, so unlike the -$2.92 EPS quarter that produced last year's -17.93% there is no derivative line left to blow out tonight's GAAP headline.

Lesson 6 (verify the bar) is the binding constraint on the whole name: WSJ and Nasdaq estimate pages were both unreachable, the FY2026 revenue bar rests on one source, and the FY2026 EPS consensus of -$1.14 was discarded outright because 9M actual EPS is already -$1.66. Every size above is capped small for that reason and `bar` says so.

Lesson 8 (thin coverage means a confirmed fact moves more) is why expected_move_pct is -5.0 against a finding sum of -4.3 rather than being rounded toward zero — the name's own distribution has 3 of 7 prints beyond 10% on a 7.56m float.

Lesson 9 (size a segment finding net of the rest) is why print_vs_bar_pct is only -1.0: I am bearish on ADHD, which is ~62% of the Q4 quarter, and bullish on EXXUA at ~31%, and the net against the only sourceable bar is close to flat.
